js: 'The Engines page in the modern design (WP8), on made-up data (scripts/drive/engines-fake.js answers the builds, a build s runs, the images, the downloads and the live feed s jobs): the list beside the detail, selection by click, by the arrow keys and Home/End, a deep link, the search, the live run card, the images as rows grouped by engine, the editor modal from the header, the narrow window s one pane with its back button, the light theme, and the Downloads page s groups with a live transfer. It starts nothing and writes nothing (the fake refuses every write op): safe with the GPU hold on. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/engines-split.json --dsf 1.25 --block-writes --init-script scripts/drive/engines-fake.js --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr> --podman-guard <prefix> --shots <dir>'

label: the list has the three builds and Local images

expect: document.querySelector('.engines-split .mdetail-pane .detail-hero h1').textContent === 'Engines' && [...document.querySelectorAll('.mdetail-pane .pref-head h2')].some(h => h.textContent === 'Start a build')
label: nothing selected: the overview with where to start a build
the list head: the title and its icon buttons

until: document.location.pathname === '/backends/builds/1' && document.querySelector('.mdetail-pane .detail-hero h1').textContent === 'Official master' && document.querySelectorAll('.mdetail-pane table.bk-runs tbody tr').length === 2

the build s groups: Source, Image, Updates, Runs

the waiting update shows in the hero and the Updates group

a live run: Log in the header, podman s last line in the card
the list row says the live phase

a group per engine, its heading with how many and their size

expect: (() => { const n = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mdetail-pane .prow.bk-img-row .bk-img-name')].find(x => x.textContent === 'localhost/lmgw-dev-llama.cpp:official-master-0123456-89abcde'); return n && n.checkVisibility() &&n.scrollWidth <= n.clientWidth + 1 && getComputedStyle(n).textOverflow !== 'ellipsis' && n.closest('.prow').querySelector('.bk-img-tags').textContent.includes(':official-master'); })()
label: the first line has the full tag, nothing cut, and the other tag under it

expect: (() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mdetail-pane .prow.bk-img-row')].find(x => x.querySelector('.bk-img-name').textContent.includes('official-master-0123456')); const name = r.querySelector('.bk-img-name').getBoundingClientRect(); const sub = r.querySelector('.bk-img-sub'); const st = r.querySelector('.bk-img-state'); const chips = [...st.querySelectorAll('.type-badge')].map(c => c.textContent).join('|'); return chips === 'chat default|aux default|model demo-embed-4b-q4-k-m-cpu' && st.getBoundingClientRect().top >= sub.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 1 && sub.getBoundingClientRect().top >= name.bottom - 1 && sub.textContent.includes('GiB') && sub.textContent.includes('build Official master') && st.querySelector('.chip.ok'); })()
label: the used-by chips sit on the entry's sub-line, under the facts, with the run's state

expect: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mdetail-pane .prow.bk-img-row')]; const upd = rows.find(r => r.querySelector('.bk-img-name').textContent.includes('audio.cpp:v1-demo')); const hand = rows.find(r => r.querySelector('.bk-img-name').textContent.includes('ik-main-demo-build')); return upd && upd.querySelector('.bk-img-state .chip.warn').textContent.includes('update') && upd.querySelector('.prow-end').textContent.includes('Pull update') && upd.querySelector('.bk-img-sub').textContent.includes('pulled from a registry') && hand && hand.querySelector('.bk-img-state .dim').textContent === 'unused' && hand.querySelector('.bk-img-sub').textContent.includes('external') && rows.every(r => r.querySelector('.prow-end .row-acts .btn') && r.querySelector('.prow-end .row-acts .row-menu, .prow-end .row-acts button[aria-haspopup]')); })()
label: the registry image has its update chip and Pull update; an unused one says so quietly; every row has Delete and its menu
